canonicalization: UTF-8 bytes of JSON.stringify object with fields in the exact canonical_payload_order; public_key is the exported JWK object as serialized by browser; no whitespace
signature_encoding: standard base64 of WebCrypto ECDSA signature bytes
public_key_format: JWK EC P-256 without private component d
signature_verification: Browser local Web Crypto verify; no server-side verification or identity attestation
security: Private keys stay with participant. No unique human/AI proof; keys can be duplicated and answers copied. No trusted nonce issuer currently.
